data.narrative:
Hypersonix Launch Systems, a Series A defense & security company, has raised $46M AUD to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity. The peer set ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two valuation methods triangulate the target's value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $46M capital raised proxy, yielding $92M. The peer-median method across the 11-company comparison set produces $1.0B, reflecting valuations of sampled peers ranging from Twenty ($1.0B, Series B) through Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B). The dispersion across methods reflects stage and maturity variance within the defense & security frontier-tech cohort.

Triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $78M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $546M. The wide range reflects genuine uncertainty around (1) stage-appropriateness relative to the peer set, which skews toward later-stage rounds, and (2) the nascent and heterogeneous nature of frontier-defense technology valuations. The median point represents a more conservative midpoint between methodological outputs. Near-term fundraising performance and program validation will likely narrow this band.
